title: fix(organizations): the organization seed ownership claim writes with skipAutomations — no app hooks or record-change flows for a bookkeeping write
body:
Fixes #23008
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`claimOrgSeedOwnership` (`@objectstack/organizations`) hands an organization's owner-less seeded rows to its owner. Its per-row write now runs under `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }` (`CLAIM_WRITE_CTX`) instead of a bare `{ isSystem: true }`, the context its single-tenant twin `claimSeedOwnership` already uses. The card carries no maintainer ruling; the binding direction is triage's grade on the card (comment 6123012416), verbatim:

> `claimOrgSeedOwnership` writes with `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }`, with #22069's pin: a metadata-bound hook does not run, and a code-registered hook (audit, sharing projection) still does.

No metadata-bound hook runs on the claim's owner change and no record-change flow is dispatched for it, so no approval opens and no notification goes out for the bookkeeping write. Code-registered hooks (the audit writer, capability gates, the sharing projection) still run on every claimed row. The per-object read stays a plain `{ isSystem: true }` read; see "The read" below.

| file | change |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` | `CLAIM_WRITE_CTX` beside `SYSTEM_CTX`, used by the update only; the header says why, and which hooks still run |
| `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.test.ts` | new case: every `update` call carries exactly `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }`, every `find` exactly `{ isSystem: true }` |
| `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership-dispatch.pin.test.ts` (new) | real `ObjectQL` over `SqliteWasmDriver` (the driver `objectstack dev` uses): what the flag reaches |
| `.changeset/23008-org-seed-claim-skip-automations.md` | `patch` for `@objectstack/organizations` |

No `package.json` or lockfile change: `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` were already devDependencies of the package.

## What the pin asserts, on the real engine

1. **The metadata-hook filter.** A hook bound through the real binder (`bindHooksToEngine`, which stamps `entry.meta`) on `beforeUpdate`/`afterUpdate` sees 0 write dispatches during the claim.
2. **The per-row hook path.** A code-registered hook (`registerHook`, no metadata) fires once per claimed row and phase. Ids are compared, not only counted: 12 rows, 2 phases.
3. **The record-change trigger's reading point.** Every one of those contexts carries `isSystem: true`, `skipAutomations: true` and `session.skipTriggers: true`, the field `RecordChangeTrigger` reads before it dispatches a flow.

There are two positive controls on the same engine. During the claim, the same metadata hook, also bound on `beforeFind`/`afterFind`, sees the claim's read (exactly one `beforeFind` and one `afterFind`), so it is live while the write events stay silent. After the claim, the claim's own by-id write shape under a bare `{ isSystem: true }` fires the metadata hook 2N times, and the code hook sees no skip flag. An owned row and another organization's owner-less row stay untouched. A second case pins that a re-run claims nothing and dispatches no write hook of either kind.

## Ablation: drop `skipAutomations`, the pin goes red

The change was committed first (`04d20c038`), and the mutation was made from that state with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under the verify lock, with an outer `trap` restore on the absolute path. Both test files import their subject as `./claim-org-seed-ownership.js`, which is `src/`, so no `dist/` sits in the resolution path.

- Mutation landed: anchor `const CLAIM_WRITE_CTX = { isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true };` went from 1 to 0, the replacement `const CLAIM_WRITE_CTX = { isSystem: true };` from 0 to 1, and the blob from `8474e3b66319` to `814e30575673`.
- Mutated run: `Tests  2 failed | 6 passed (8)`. The pin failed on half 1:

```text
AssertionError: a metadata-bound hook fired for the claim write: expected [ …(24) ] to deeply equal []
+   { "event": "beforeUpdate", "id": "d0", "isSystem": true, "skipAutomations": undefined, "skipTriggers": undefined },
```

  The unit test's context assertion failed as well.
- Restore proven: the blob after restore is `8474e3b66319`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The restored run: `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  8 passed (8)`.

## The read: measured, then chosen

- **Measured.** `find` dispatches `beforeFind`/`afterFind` through `triggerHooks`, so a metadata-bound find hook does fire on an `isSystem`-only read. The pin observes it on the real engine: one of each per claimed object.
- **Chosen.** Keep the read plain, as the twin does. A read starts no record-change flow; the approvals and emails this card is about come from write hooks and flows. A metadata-bound `beforeFind` hook is an app's read-filter seam, and switching it off would change which rows the claim selects relative to every other system read of that object. No consumer was measured either way: `examples/` and `packages/qa` at `9f4b652e3` declare 0 metadata-bound find hooks (grep for `beforeFind` and `afterFind`: 0 hits).

## Verification

`origin/main` was merged once (`a1a4f4025`). The merge brought 4 paths: two ADRs and two `scripts/adr-anchors/*.json`, with no package source.

- Tests: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations test` gave `Test Files  13 passed (13)`, `Tests  155 passed (155)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations typecheck` passed: `tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 file(s), 0 error(s). Both ran at `04d20c038`; the merge touched no package file.
- Gates at `a1a4f4025`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 commands over the 4 changed paths. That is the dispatch's 51 plus the changeset families: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` (each with its self-test), `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, and the `release-rehearsal-clone` and `release-pending-publish` self-tests.
  - All 64 ran and every one exited 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3: the tree had no full build). `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` then built the closure, the gate was re-run, and it exited 0.
  - `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` were re-run after that build so they cover this package: 72 and 69 built packages swept, against 48 the first time.
  - `--ran` with exit codes: `Run reconciliation — 64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, and the zero is derived from the recorded codes.
- Lint, a declared narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed TypeScript files at `a1a4f4025` gave 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - Population: all three match `eslint.config.mjs`'s `packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}` object, and none was ignored (an ignored file passed explicitly reports a warning).
  - Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **The 10,000-row read limit: measured, reproduces, out of this PR** (triage's direction). An untracked scratch test, since deleted, ran the real engine with 10,500 owner-less rows of one object in one organization. The claim returned `count: 10000`: 10,000 owned and 500 unowned, in one 5.0 s pass. The production caller reaches the claim through `createEnsureDefaultOrganizationOnce`, the ADR-0093 D7 once-gate. Once the owner bind is decided, the bootstrap "binds nobody and hands over no seed ownership", so the remainder stays unowned through that caller. It goes to the seat as its own card, naming the paged predicate write the twin adopted (#14530).
- The changeset does not say that no example app is affected. `examples/app-showcase` declares `record-after-update` flows on `showcase_task` and `showcase_project`; whether any of them matched the claim's owner change was not measured.
- No booted-app (dogfood) counterpart is added. The twin has `packages/qa/dogfood/test/seed-ownership-claim-dispatch.dogfood.test.ts` for the single-tenant claim. This PR's dispatch evidence is the real-engine pin, within the file surface of the dispatch.
- Cloud's adapter in objectstack-ai/cloud#2794, which adds the flag before calling this function, can retire with cloud's next framework pin.
